_meta.spec: Trading Bot — Falsification-Hardened Specification v4, Section 1.1
_meta.note: Every field below is a LOCKED risk/execution parameter per v4 Section 1.1: it carries a version-locked definition and a timestamp predating any results that would justify it. Do not edit a value here after seeing how it performs — that is exactly the unfalsifiable practice this registry exists to prevent. To change a locked value: pick the new value BEFORE observing new results under it, update it here with a fresh locked_at timestamp and rationale, then deploy. tick.py hard-refuses new entries (WAIT) if its live constants don't match this file's hash.

locked_by: owner (v5 market-intelligence decision layer, Market Intelligence Research Report)

HARD_SL_FRAC.rationale: RE-LOCKED a priori 2026-09-10 BEFORE any results under v5: prior 0.12 sat beyond the ~9.5% liquidation point at 10x isolated leverage, so live it could never be the first exit. 0.06 sits well inside liq, caps tail loss at 60% of slot margin, and makes the scalp EV structure viable: breakeven win rate 0.06/(0.06+0.014) ~= 0.81, below the 93.8% backtest win rate. Derived from liquidation math + EV geometry, not performance tuning.

MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS.rationale: Hard age ceiling. TP_AGING (below) only relaxes the profit target with age; it never forces an exit. This is the actual forced exit the prior design lacked.

SL_ATR_MULT.rationale: INHERITED FROM PRE-v4 GRID SEARCH (1152 configs) — flagged, not re-derived. Chosen by picking the value that performed best on the same backtest data (grid-search-on-results). This is the exact practice v4 Section 1.1 prohibits for locked parameters. Retained as-is for continuity; NOT re-certified under v4 discipline. Any future change to this value must be locked before seeing new results, per this registry.

TP_SL_RATIO.rationale: Same inheritance caveat as SL_ATR_MULT — pre-v4 grid-search origin, not re-derived under v4 discipline.

SCALP_TP_ATR.rationale: Pre-v4 two-week lab sweep result. Same inheritance caveat.

LEVERAGE.rationale: Locked leverage per spec Section 8.3 ("leverage is locked and versioned").

MAX_POSITIONS.rationale: OWNER decision after the concentration trial review: back to 8 slots — same engine decisions, but each loss is sliced to ~1/8 of budget instead of one kill outweighing a month of wins. Whole-account value 1 preserved with its sim disclosure (-30%/month vs +10.7%/month at 8 slots, identical signals).

MARGIN_BUDGET.rationale: Owner-set, 2026-09-07 watch-period value; live-plan target noted as 0.40 in comments but not yet switched.

SAFE_DD.rationale: Realized-drawdown wall pausing new entries only — does not cap floating/unrealized exposure. Superseded in practice by HARD_SL_FRAC + MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS for existing positions.

TP_AGING_TIERS.rationale: Target relaxation only, never a forced exit — see MAX_POS_AGE_HOURS.

EV_PRIOR_WINRATE.rationale: Locked a priori 2026-09-10: pseudo-observed win rate blended into p_win for the EV gate. Conservative vs 93.8% backtest win rate; above the ~0.81 EV breakeven for the 1.6x-ATR TP geometry.

EV_PRIOR_WEIGHT.rationale: Locked a priori: pseudo-trade weight of the prior vs observed W/L since reset. 20 = the prior dominates until ~20 real trades accumulate, then evidence takes over.

EV_MARGIN_REQ.rationale: Locked a priori: EV per unit of notional must clear this AFTER fees + assumed slip + expected kill loss. Entry with no EV margin is not a smaller trade — it is WAIT.

SLIP_ASSUMED_PCT.rationale: OWNER RELEASE: bot trades $3-30 notional clips on the deepest Bitget books; realized slippage at that size is spread-level. The old 5bp/side planning charge was calibrated for large live orders, not micro clips.

TREND_RUNAWAY_CANDLES.rationale: Locked a priori: last 6 closed 15m candles all one color = runaway regime; counter-trend entries blocked (the 09-06 wedge lesson, structural, not tuned).

SPIKE_RANGE_MULT.rationale: Locked a priori: live 1m candle range > 3x 1m ATR = spike/manipulation regime; entries blocked that tick.

PAIRS.rationale: Multi-pair expansion (owner-approved): five deepest-liquidity Bitget USDT perps. Locked a priori at expansion — pairs are added/removed only by explicit owner decision + registry edit, never mid-epoch.

MIN_TP_DIST_FRAC.rationale: OWNER RELEASE (owner-authorized override after 20h zero-trade deadlock): 0.6% TP floor. At the old 0.125% floor, fees+slip+planning loss made EV negative in every calm regime, so the gate never passed. 0.6% clears the cost stack with real capture. Prior value 0.00125 (2026-09-10 lock) preserved here for the record.

EV_ASSUMED_LOSS_FRAC.rationale: OWNER RELEASE: the EV gate plans against a 2% adverse move instead of the full 6% HARD_SL. HARD_SL_FRAC 0.06 remains the actual exit backstop unchanged; this is the gate's planning assumption only.

DYN_SL.rationale: P2 risk engine: breakeven protection enabled (owner position-management spec).

BE_TRIGGER_FRAC.rationale: Empirical (mfe_mae_seed_NEAR_30d.json): 141/146 trades reach 50% of TP distance and 91% of those hit TP — arm risk-free status exactly there.

MAE_CEIL_FRAC.rationale: Empirical: winners' MAE p90 = 2.89%; only ~5/128 winners bled past 4% while all 7 HARD_SL deaths ride through 4% toward 6% — ceiling costs ~5 small wins but cuts every tail kill by a third.

BE_BUFFER_FRAC.rationale: Round-trip fees (0.12%) + assumed slip (0.02%) + crumb: BE_STOP exits cover costs, never lock a guaranteed loss.

CONCENTRATED.rationale: OWNER decision: slot-based sizing restored. The param stays in the registry as a documented one-flip switch for future experiments.

RECOVERY_SIZE_FRAC.rationale: OWNER 2026-09-11 (Phase 4 finding 1): SAFE_DD 25% wall as originally designed paused ALL entries below the boundary — a one-way freeze, since a paused account can never recover (all 4 non-NEAR pairs latched Aug 19-21 and sat silent for the rest of the month). Owner decision: recovery sizing — below the wall, slots run at 1/4 size (floored at the $1 dust minimum so the account keeps trading); full size returns automatically when balance recovers above the boundary. SAFE_DD itself (0.25) is UNCHANGED. First empirical result under the new rule (NEAR 30d sim): wall tripped at trade #338; recovery era = 3,836 dust trades, net -$0.32 (vs $0 and total silence under the old pause). Slightly negative grind in a 3-week-below-wall window — recorded here so the rule is judged on evidence, not vibes.

DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT.rationale: OWNER 2026-09-11 (Phase 4 finding 2): the 12% daily circuit breaker was documented since the single-pair era but never wired — DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT had zero readers and _day_start_balance was computed and discarded. Owner decision: wire it for real. Realized balance down 12% from the UTC day-start close → no new entries until the next UTC day (flag rides the last_reversal_at snapshot as drd, same channel as sf). Open positions ride to TP as normal. Documented behavior now equals actual behavior.

known_gaps_not_claimed: Tier 0 exchange-native resting/placeable stop order — this bot places no real orders on any venue; every kill is a software monitor polling every ~15s.
Tier 1 independent watchdog (separate host/network path/API credentials) — single GitHub Actions process, single Bitget public API path, no second host.
Tier 2 hedge/offsetting order with stress-tested basis risk — no hedge instrument is traded.
Tier 3 venue-level account kill / dead-man's switch — not available for a read-only public-API paper sim.

Regime probability engine (R(t), entropy, transition-risk), Probability Engine calibration+sharpness, Independent Uncertainty ensemble — not implemented; current entries use deterministic EMA/ATR/color rules only.

Hypothesis Registry with N>=200 independent events per regime, FDR/Deflated-Sharpe on total N, single-use Vault with retirement rule, block-bootstrap CPCV validation — not implemented; sweep.py/research.py perform grid search directly against backtest results, which v4 Section 1.1 explicitly treats as unfalsifiable, not as a passing validation protocol.
